prompt:
New fantasy raid arena concept painting, wide landscape 2:1.
The attached paintings are STYLE AND COMPOSITION references. Image 1 is the PRIMARY reference for broad visible brushwork, suggested forms, quiet detail, softened distant edges and luminous lava. Image 2 supports the simple dark rock masses and restrained fiery palette. Image 3 supports atmospheric depth and a single winding lava route. Create an original scene; do not reproduce the reference composition or its dragon-shaped sculptures.

The raid boss is Ashmaw, a huge molten red dragon. Wide arena-focused camera. A broad, quiet dark basalt arena occupies the lower half. One winding ribbon of molten orange lava guides the eye around its edge toward Ashmaw on a distant raised ledge in the upper-right third. His low, heavy head with two swept horns, neck and planted foreclaws emerge from smoke; his wing is one large dark shape merging into the cliff. His grounded silhouette is unmistakably a threatening dragon. Most of his body disappears into deep red-brown shadow. Only the amber eye, a little furnace glow in the mouth, and a few broken orange rim accents describe him. Suggest his scales with a handful of brush marks; do not explain his armor plate by plate.

Use just a few large rock/cliff shapes and two broad distant lava falls, with faded mountains in haze. No forest of towers, intricate castle bridges, carved ornament, giant glowing cracks on every surface, or repetitive tiny details. Leave broad calm areas in the arena and sky. No painted raid characters yet: the empty arena is intentional space for the game's party and battle effects.

Painterly fantasy illustration, confident economical brush strokes, large grouped shadow shapes, lost and found edges, soft smoke, atmospheric perspective. A simple value structure: dark foreground, muted middle distance, one warm luminous area behind the boss. Deep charcoal and burnt maroon, molten orange, subdued warm grey haze. Lava is the main bright accent; most stone remains dark and softly suggested. Put detail only where it earns attention. NO glossy 3D, photoreal microtexture, oversharpened high-frequency detail, decorative noise or etched scale patterns. No text, watermark, UI or border. Aim for the visual restraint and hand-painted feel of the supplied references.
